title: Arsenal fixtures
description: Arsenal men's first-team matches for the season, soonest first. On a match day the home page shows a small gothic A by the theme toggle. scripts/arsenal_fixtures.py refreshes the Premier League and Champions League from fixturedownload.com and keeps every other competition as it is, so cup ties are added by hand.

kickoff.description: Kickoff in UTC, like 2026-11-01T16:30:00Z. The page shows the mark on that day in the visitor's own time zone.
